Everything is stored only on this device, in a local database. There is no account, no advertising and no tracking or analytics.
Food journal, weight and measurements, foods, recipes, goals and settings. This is health-related data.

The only network access is to Open Food Facts, and only when the option is on in Settings. It receives the barcode or the search words. Like any internet server, it also sees your IP address, the time of the request and the app version (User-Agent). See their policy: https://world.openfoodfacts.org/privacy
The camera is used only to read barcodes. Images are not saved.
Android cloud backup is disabled for this app. ZIP backups and CSV exports are written unencrypted where you choose. If you place them in a cloud service, they leave your device.
Erasure: use \"Erase all my data\" in Settings. Portability: use the backup or the CSV exports. Uninstalling the app deletes everything it stores.
